notes.2026-10-21 direct audio uploads: Measured (bun run build:frontend, then bun ./scripts/check-web-export-budget.mjs) on top of core 6.5.0: initialJavaScript* rise to 7,870,814 raw / 2,008,502 gzip as CI measures them (local gzip is 3 bytes lower), +5,069 / +1,370 over the core 6.5.0 measurement (7,865,745 / 2,007,132). The locker upload now sends audio straight to storage on a presigned PUT, because api.syra.fm moves behind a proxy that refuses request bodies over 100 MB: @syra.fm/sdk's sendAudioUpload (XHR PUT with byte progress), shared-types' audioUpload contract and the app's directAudioUpload glue. Metro does not tree-shake and both packages already load with the entry, so the new code lands there wherever it is imported from. expo-file-system, which streams the file from disk on a device, is confined to services/deviceAudioFile.native.ts and never reaches the web bundle (importing it directly measured +28,586 raw / +6,460 gzip).
